dmp.description:
The Data Management Plan is developed in the framework of the Fundamental and Applied Research project (Latvia)  “Continuity of Livonian: Understanding language transmission processes in a critically endangered contemporary indigenous community to develop process-driven instruments for preservation and revitalisation” (Nr. lzp-2023/1-0264). 
Data collection includes interviews, background data and relations of Livonian speakers, community and participants of Livonian data transmission processes.
